sourceChecks.note: Fries Museum: Margaretha Geertruida Zelle born August 7, 1876 in Leeuwarden; stage name Mata Hari; accepted German money as 'agent H21' while trying to work as a French spy; executed by firing squad 'October 15th, 1917' at Vincennes; Captain Bouchardon 'cannot prove that she actually provided the Germans with incriminating information'.

Britannica: 'On July 25, 1917, a French military court found Mata Hari guilty of spying for Germany during World War I'; shot three months later; 'The German government publicly exculpated her in 1930'; documents released by France in 2017 'led many to believe that she had been a scapegoat'.
